The current place structure is:
:'''banzu''' = x1 (object) suffices/is enough/sufficient for purpose x2 under conditions x3
:'''sarcu''' = x1 (abstract) is necessary/required for continuing state/process x2 under conditions x3.

:'''dukse''' = x1 is an excess of/too much of x2 by standard x3.

The place structure proposed by [[la gleki]] is:
:'''banzu''' = x1 suffices/is enough/sufficient for purpose x2 under conditions x3
:'''sarcu''' = x1 is necessary/required for continuing state/process x2 under conditions x3.

:'''dukse''' = x1 is in excess for purpose x2 under conditions x3
